message_user: BREAKING: Stock Open Higher; CoreWeave, Cava Dive   IBD Digital Summer Sale  ibddigital marketsurge ibdlive leaderboard swingtrader marketdiem Store Subscribe Sign In ibd logo Market Trend Stock Lists Research News Videos Learn Store  Search stocks or keywords Stock Market Today Stock Market Today: Dow Jones Index Rises But Nvidia-Backed CoreWeave, Cava Plunge On Earnings (Live Coverage) FacebookXLinkedInShare Licensing SCOTT LEHTONENUpdated 09:46 AM ET 08/13/2025 The Dow Jones Industrial Average and other major stock indexes marched up Wednesday, following up on the stock market rally to new highs in the prior session. Meanwhile, Nvidia (NVDA)-backed CoreWeave (CRWV) and Cava Group (CAVA) plunged on the stock market today after both reported second-quarter results.  After the opening bell, the Dow rose 0.5%, as the S&P 500 gained 0.4%. The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite climbed 0.5% in morning trade. The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq closed at record highs on Tuesday as rate-cut odds bolted higher following July inflation data.  The 10-year Treasury yield ticked lower to 4.25%. Oil prices continued to lag, with West Texas Intermediate futures moving below $63 a barrel.  Among exchange traded funds, the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) tacked on 0.4%. Also, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) rose 0.3% after Wednesday's market open.  Nasdaq-100 Winners, Losers: AMD, DoorDash Within the Nasdaq -100 index, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) and Palo Alto Networks (PANW) were among the best performers at the market open. AMD stock rallied 4.8%, hitting a new 52-week high. Palo Alto shares rose 1.8%, on pace to add to Tuesday's 4.3% advance.  On the downside, Intel (INTC) and DoorDash (DASH) declined 1.3% and 1.2%, respectively.  8:53 a.m. ET Dow Jones Movers: 3M, American Express, Cisco, Nike, UnitedHealth Inside the Dow Jones Industrial Average, 3M (MMM), American Express (AXP), Cisco Systems (CSCO), Nike (NKE) and UnitedHealth Group (UNH) were among the top performers in early morning trading.  3M stock climbed 0.6%, looking to extend a win streak to seven sessions, while American Express shares gained 0.8%.  Cisco stock rose 0.5%, in buying range above a 69.78 entry. The networking giant will report earnings late Wednesday.  Nike stock moved up 0.7% Wednesday premarket, while UnitedHealth advanced 1.7%, on pace to add to Tuesday's 3.7% rally.  8:29 a.m. ET Stock Market Today: Circle Stock Sells Off On Share Offering Late Tuesday, Circle Internet (CRCL) announced that it is offering up to 10 million shares in a public offering, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The company plans to offer 2 million shares of its common stock, while selling stockholders are offering 8 million shares. Underwriters also have a 30-day option to purchase up to 1.5 million shares.  Circle stock sold off nearly 3% premarket Wednesday.  8:08 a.m. ET Nvidia-Backed CoreWeave, Cava Stock Plunge Nvidia-backed CoreWeave reported a higher-than-expected second-quarter loss while revenue beat Wall Street estimates amid surging artificial intelligence compute demand. But CoreWeave stock dived 9% Wednesday as investors digested a smaller revenue beat than in the March quarter and updated guidance.  Nvidia owns a 7% stake in CoreWeave and is a strategic partner.  Meanwhile, restaurant chain Cava plunged 24% after the company reported worse-than-expected Q2 sales results. The Mediterranean fast-casual eatery also cut its full-year same-store sales outlook.  Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Nasdaq Hit New Highs The stock market rally posted a strong, broad advance Tuesday, with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 acing fresh highs. The July CPI report showed core inflation picking up, helping to boost the odds of a Fed rate cut in September.  As it stands now, futures traders currently think there's a 94% chance of a quarter-point cut at the Federal Reserve's September meeting, according to the CME FedWatch tool. After that, the market is still debating whether monetary policymakers will cut rates at their October or December meeting.
